items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: but the greatest deal was when we played for the president

ctx.x: You were here and they booked you from here.

That's right, but the greatest deal was when we played for the president, and that was -- oh, man, that was something, boy. I thought the guys was joking. He had some of those little stenographers, photographers, all of them listening to us out at Milton's, you understand me, about six of them, man.
